findings.evidence: The payoff highlights 이면 inside 두 잔이면 for the word 이 (Sino-Korean two), but 이면 is the copula conditional here, not the number two.
findings.fix: Applied payoff ban for word 이 when the line contains 이면.

findings.evidence: 예약 날짜/시간이 언제예요? are both natural.
나이/시간이 어떻게 되세요? are both established polite questions in context.
The QA asks 몇 시 십 분에, hard-coding ‘ten minutes’ instead of asking the minute value; the natural question is 몇 시 몇 분에.
findings.fix: Applied QA correction to 몇 시 몇 분에.
